title: The Tech Stock I'd Buy for My Kids and Not Look at Again for 20 Years
author: Micah Zimmerman
description: Bentley Systems is recommended as a long-term infrastructure software investment for a 20-year horizon. The company provides essential engineering tools for designing and managing critical infrastructure like bridges, roads, water systems, and power grids across 190+ countries. Despite a 30% stock decline over the past year due to AI-related sector concerns, Bentley's strong competitive moat—based on deep customer lock-in through decades-long infrastructure projects and embedded digital asset data—positions it well to benefit from an estimated $15 trillion global infrastructure investment gap by 2040.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The article presents Bentley as an attractive long-term buy despite recent stock declines. The company has a durable competitive moat based on customer lock-in through multi-decade infrastructure projects, serves essential infrastructure needs globally, and is strategically integrating AI (Blyncsy, Bentley Copilot) to enhance products. The massive $15 trillion infrastructure investment gap through 2040 provides substantial tailwinds for the business.

title: This Industrial Stock Could Be Worth $25 Billion
